breakdown.description: The prompt substitutes the bending second moment I for the polar moment J in torsion formulas, even though solid circular shaft torsion is governed by J = π d^4/32.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses J = π d^4/32 for the polar moment of inertia in both the shear stress formula (τ_max = T c / J) and the angle of twist formula (φ = TL/(JG)). There is no mention of using the bending second moment I = π d^4/64, which was the erroneous instruction in the incomplete prompt. This aligns with the ground truth prompt.
